title: controlplane-shift-handoff-annotated-log-2026-11-06
summary: Annotated standup/handoff capturing today’s control plane shift: routing quota spike, auth token refresh flake, canary rollback notes and action items. Meant as lightweight record for next shift and incoming on-call.
content:
Context: Morning shift (09:30–10:00 PT) run by Aisha. Quick sync to hand off to evening rotation. Notes are intentionally terse; include links + ticket references for deeper context.

Attendees: Aisha (handoff), Evan (routing), Marcos (auth), Priya (quotas), Jonah (SRE on-call)

Top items / Observations:
- Routing quota anomaly (08:05–08:40): brief spike in route-level quota exhaustion for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Root cause hypothesis: new batcher config (batch-size cap) touched last night by PLT-3268 PR — caused cascaded backlog and request sharding which temporarily mis-counted tokens in the rate limiter. Metric: 3.2k rate-limited requests during window, P95 latency +120ms.
  - Temporary mitigation: bumped route quota pool for core-tenant-proxy by +15% (Priya). Rollback planned if no further regressions.
  - Follow-ups: PLT-3321 created to add end-to-end quota counters in the allocator -> owner Evan, due 2026-11-10.

- Auth token refresh flake (intermittent): multiple 401s observed from internal health-checks to control plane (Marcos tracked). Symptoms: short-lived 401s when rotating KMS keys during scheduled nightly job. Not user-facing but increases noise in SLO alerts.
  - Short term: added suppressor rule for health-check alerts (Jonah) until rotation logic fixed.
  - Long term: PLT-3334 to add pre-warm token cache + idempotent rotate path (owner Marcos).

- Canary rollback and rollout notes: Canary of controlplane-service v2.14.1 saw slightly elevated error rate on path /internal/model-metadata read (0.6% -> 1.7%). Canary automatically rolled back per rollout policy.
  - Action: gather trace examples and diff kernels for v2.14.1 -> PR checklist for rollout gating (Aisha to own, due 2026-11-09). Linked: github.com/redwood/ctl/PR/4821

- Quotas test harness: Priya ran quota-fairness bench for multi-tenant profiles. Observed small unfairness for tenants with mixed short/long requests; likely batching thresholds skew behavior.
  - Item: add synthetic workload with 80/20 short/long shapes to the CI suite (ticket PLT-3342).

Action items (explicit):
- Evan: PLT-3321 (add allocator quota counters + e2e test) - due 2026-11-10 - add one extra log field for route-id.
- Marcos: PLT-3334 (auth rotate idempotency + pre-warm) - due 2026-11-16 - include KMS rotation playbook update.
- Aisha: Draft rollout gating checklist and add to confluence + link in the release PR template - due 2026-11-09.
- Priya: Add synthetic mixed-shape workload to quota bench (PLT-3342) and run overnight - due 2026-11-08.
- Jonah: Keep suppressor rule active; validate no missed user-facing alerts by 2026-11-07 EOD.

Open questions / notes to incoming shift:
- Keep an eye on any new rate-limiter counter deltas; if the seen pattern returns, apply emergency limit increase on core-tenant-proxy and escalate to platform leads.
- If KMS rotation runs tonight, Marcos to signal start in #platform-controlplane-ops and disable noisy health-check alerts.
- Canary rollback logs stored in S3: s3://redwood-controlplane/canary-logs/2026-11-06/ — look for traces with tag rollout=v2.14.1

Random scratch / fragments (notes-to-self):
- Follow up with infra about batcher config release window (who merged: mjones?)
- Consider an abbreviated postmortem if routing-quota spike impacts SLA beyond 1 hour.
- Investigate token-rotate flake correlation with kube-controller-manager pod restarts.

Useful links referenced in meeting:
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PLAT/Control+Plane+Runbook
- Routing quota dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/controlplane/routing-quotas
- Canary logs: s3://redwood-controlplane/canary-logs/2026-11-06/
- PR: github.com/redwood/ctl/PR/4821

Closing note: handing off to evening rotation (Evan). Please ack in the channel and paste any immediate anomalies into the ticket PLT-3321.

-- end of annotated handoff (Aisha)
